scope: Any valid M4 trace upper bound and any one-term Rayleigh numerator whose delta=rho8-2rho4 is at least19/1250; same initial time-first/transported [8,16] window. The saved two-vector span also obeys this bound.
consequence: On beta<=12, transported P=a^2*b<69/100. The ideal first-window purity is (sqrt(2P-1)+(2P-1))/2<1/2 because sqrt(19/50)<31/50 when P>1/2, otherwise its domain fails. On beta>=12, z<1/2 implies b<1/2 and P<1/2. Thus the fixed recipe cannot certify its first [8,16] window at any beta. This limits recipe outputs, not physical ratios.
